cards.text: What is a small thing that reliably makes your day better, and when did you last get it?
What were you really into as a kid that nobody around you understood?
What is the best meal someone has ever cooked for you, and who made it?
Which of your habits would surprise the people who only know you from work?
What song do you turn up when nobody else is in the car?
What is something you are weirdly good at that has never once been useful?
If you had a free Saturday with no obligations and no phone, how would it actually go?
What is the last thing that made you laugh so hard it hurt?
What is a smell that instantly puts you somewhere else?
What did you want to be when you were nine, and what happened to that?
What is a compliment you still remember years later?
What is your order at the place you have been going to forever?
What is a rule you had growing up that you now think was ridiculous?
Which fictional character did you secretly feel was you?
What is a skill you taught yourself from scratch, and why that one?
What is the pettiest hill you will die on?
What is a place you have been exactly once that you still think about?
What do you do when you cannot sleep?
What is the most useless thing you own that you refuse to get rid of?
Who was your first real friend, and what did the two of you do together?
What is a word or phrase you say far too much?
What is a food you pretended to like for years?
What did you do recently that your younger self would think was really cool?
What is a tradition you have kept that most people have dropped?
If your mood right now were weather, what is the forecast for tonight?
What is the best gift you have ever given someone?
What do you always notice first when you walk into a room?
What is a tiny thing you are proud of that you have never told anyone?
What did your childhood bedroom look like?
What is a question you wish people asked you more often?
What is the last thing you looked up that you would be embarrassed to explain?
Who in your life makes you laugh the hardest, and what is their move?
What do people get wrong about you, and why do you let them?
When was the last time you cried, and what was it actually about?
What is a habit you have that you would be embarrassed for me to see?
What is something you never apologized for but should have?
Which version of you do you like least: the one at work, with family, or with friends?
What is a belief you have quietly changed your mind about in the last few years?
What do you do to look busy or fine when you are neither?
What is a lie you tell yourself that has gotten harder to believe?
Who are you jealous of right now, and what do they have?
What are you most afraid people will find out you do not know how to do?
What is a decision you made quickly that you have been living with for a long time?
What do you need from people that you have trouble asking for?
What is something you did for attention that you now regret?
When do you feel most like a fraud?
What part of your personality did you build on purpose?
What is a grudge you are still carrying that you know you should drop?
What is something you miss that you would never admit to missing?
Who did you stop talking to, and what did you tell yourself about why?
What are you putting off because finishing it would mean something?
What is the nicest thing you have done that nobody knows about?
How do you act when you are hurt, and how long does it take you to say so?
What is a compliment you do not believe when you get it?
What do you do that you would judge someone else for doing?
What is the kindest thing anyone has said to you that you brushed off at the time?
What is something about your body or your health you have been avoiding dealing with?
What is an opinion you keep to yourself because of who you are usually around?
What is a moment you were a coward, and what would you do now?
What are you tired of pretending to care about?
What have you bought to try to become a different kind of person?
What is the last thing you were wrong about and did not say so?
What do you do when someone compliments something you faked?
What is the most selfish thing you did this year, and would you do it again?
What is the thing you have worked hardest to make sure nobody sees?
Who taught you how to love, and what did they teach you wrong?
What happened to you that you have never told the full story of?
What do you think your parents still do not understand about you?
What is a moment you knew something in your life was over before anyone said it?
When did you first feel like an adult, and was it a good day?
What do you want said about you that is not true yet?
What have you had to forgive someone for that they never asked forgiveness for?
What is something you lost that you still catch yourself looking for?
What would you have to give up to be happy, and why have you not?
What do you do with your anger?
Who do you owe an apology that you can no longer give?
What is the loneliest you have ever been?
What did you learn about yourself from the worst thing you have done?
What keeps you going on the days you do not feel like going?
What is a fear you have never said out loud because saying it makes it real?
When did you last feel completely safe, and where were you?
What part of your childhood are you still trying to fix as an adult?
What do you need to hear from someone who will never say it?
What do you think you were put here to do, and are you doing it?
What is a version of your life you grieve even though you chose this one?
What would the people who love you say you are hiding from?
What is a promise you made to yourself as a kid that you have kept?
If this were your last year, what would be left unfinished that only you could have finished?
What do you need to be forgiven for?
What has pain taught you that comfort never could?
Who saw you clearly at a moment you needed it, and what did they do?
What is a truth about yourself you have only recently been able to look at?
What are you still waiting for someone to notice?
What do you want the last thing you ever say to be about?
What did you have to become to survive, and do you still need to be it?
What would you tell the person you were at your lowest, if they would actually listen?
Send the other player a photo from your camera roll that you have never shown anyone, and explain it.
Describe the other player back to themselves in three honest sentences. They cannot respond until you are done.
Say the thing you almost said earlier in this session but did not.
Both of you: write down one thing you are scared the other person thinks about you. Reveal at the same time.
Tell the other player about a time they helped you without knowing it.
Sixty seconds of silence. Look at each other, or at the screen. Then say the first true thing that comes to mind.
Ask the other player any question you want. They answer or pass. No follow-ups allowed on this one.
Answer the last card again, but as the person you were ten years ago.
Share a song that explains how you have been feeling this week. The other player listens to it before anyone talks.
Give the other player a compliment you have thought but never said. Be specific.
Describe your life right now to a stranger in one paragraph without mentioning your job, your relationship, or where you live.
Pick any earlier card from this session and ask it again. The second answer has to go deeper than the first.
